chain.text: Domaine des Trois Chênes farms 18ha (11 Cabernet Franc, 7 Chenin Blanc), averaging 62,000 bottles; 2024 gave 48,000 after May hail. Organic since 2019; biodynamic conversion began 2023, certification earliest 2026. Exports are 41%, mainly Belgium and Japan, whose importer requires sulphites under 60mg/l. Two past failures: a 2022 tank 4 controller drift (€11,000 loss; now calibrated pre-harvest with a second probe) and a 2023 label error (900 bottles recalled; two signatures now required). Rules: no irrigation on western plots, harvest decided by three mornings of measurements, tanks above 28°C cooled within four hours. Pending: lighter bottles and eastern parcel replanting.
